figures.caption: Figure 5: Visualization of the A-CTR \mathcal{S}^{\mathcal{A}}_{\mathbf{\Sigma},\kappa} (primal and dual), RA-CTR \tilde{\mathcal{S}}^{\mathcal{A}}_{\mathbf{\Sigma},\kappa} (dual only) and the action-only object motion set \mathcal{M}^{\mathcal{A},\mathrm{o}}_{\mathrm{\Sigma},\kappa} under the different linearization points shown in the illustrations. In the “Trust Region” row, the “True Samples” subplot is obtained by uniformly sampling 2000 points from the ball \left\lVert{\delta u}\right\rVert\leq 0.1; samples in the following columns are obtained by rejecting samples that do not satisfy the respective constraints. In the “Object Motion Set” row, the “True Samples” subplot is obtained by passing the \delta u samples from the trust region subplot above through the true contact dynamics (8); samples in the following columns are obtained by mapping the \delta u samples from the corresponding trust region subplot through the linear map defined in (29).
figures.caption_ko: Figure 5: 그림에 표시된 서로 다른 선형화 지점에서 A-CTR(주·쌍대 제약), RA-CTR(쌍대 제약만), 행동만 고려한 물체 운동 집합을 시각화했다. Trust Region 행의 True Samples는 반지름 0.1인 행동 변화량 구에서 2000개 점을 균등 표본화해 얻었으며, 이후 열은 각 제약을 만족하지 않는 표본을 제거해 얻었다. Object Motion Set 행의 True Samples는 위 trust region의 행동 변화량 표본을 실제 접촉 동역학 식 (8)에 통과시킨 결과다. 이후 열은 대응하는 trust region의 행동 변화량 표본을 식 (29)의 선형 사상에 통과시킨 결과다.

figures.caption: Figure 21: A complete path generated by our roadmap-based global planner. The object configuration in each frame is highlighted at the lower-left corner. (a) shows the starting configuration, which in this example is a vertex already in the roadmap. (b) can be reached from (a) with a -90^{\circ} yaw. (c) has the same object configuration as (b), but the hand has repositioned for a 90^{\circ} pitch. (d) is system configuration after the pitch. (e) shows the system reaching the goal configuration from (d). The path (a)-(d) is part of the roadmap and generated offline. (d)-(e) is generated online using collision-free planning and local MPC.
figures.caption_ko: Figure 21: 로드맵 기반 전역 계획기로 생성한 완전한 경로. 각 프레임의 물체 자세는 왼쪽 아래에 강조했다. (a)는 시작 자세이며 이 예에서는 이미 로드맵에 있는 정점이다. (b)는 (a)에서 yaw -90도로 도달할 수 있다. (c)는 (b)와 물체 자세가 같지만 손이 pitch 90도를 위해 재배치되었다. (d)는 pitch 이후의 시스템 자세다. (e)는 (d)에서 목표 자세에 도달한 상태다. (a)–(d) 경로는 로드맵에 속하며 오프라인에서 생성된다. (d)–(e)는 충돌 없는 계획과 국소 MPC를 이용해 온라인에서 생성된다.

relations.note: Builds on Pang et al. (2023) CQDC and smoothing, adding primal/dual feasibility trust regions, closed-loop MPC, grasp synthesis and roadmap planning.
Section 9.1 proposes planner-generated expert trajectories for goal-conditioned diffusion policies; policy training is a future direction, not an evaluated CTR result.

ai_summary.one_liner: CTR constrains local contact models by predicted force and geometry feasibility; relaxed CTR supports low-compute MPC, grasp synthesis and cube roadmap planning.
ai_summary.problem: A symmetric ellipsoidal trust region can predict pulling where unilateral contact permits only pushing.
ai_summary.solution: Differentiate both primal configurations and dual contact forces, then intersect a local ellipsoid with feasibility constraints; R-CTR retains only dual feasibility to avoid excessive conservatism.
ai_summary.key_result: In CQDC evaluation, bimanual translation error falls from 8.6 mm (ETR) to 2.0 mm (R-CTR), and Allegro rotation error from 21.4 to 9.8 mrad. A cube roadmap is built in under 10 CPU minutes; hardware achieves 150 consecutive edge transitions before hand overheating.
limitations: Quasidynamic contact predictions differ substantially from second-order simulation and hardware.
The global connection recipe depends on Allegro kinematics and cube symmetry.
Lost contact, residual failures and the role of primal feasibility remain incompletely understood.

research_gaps.question: How can CTR-based planning maintain contact under second-order dynamics without relying on CQDC hydroplaning artifacts?
How can roadmap connections preserve object stability for asymmetric objects and unstable grasps?
Does the compute advantage persist against matched RL baselines when object diversity, sensing and online latency are controlled?

future_directions: Generalize roadmap connectivity using reachable-set approximations and stable finger gaiting.
Exploit optimization sparsity and prune inactive contact constraints to accelerate MPC.
Use planner-generated demonstrations and corrective trajectories for imitation learning; evaluate roadmap states for RL exploration.
